name: anyagent
description: TypeScript SDK for AnyAgent typed APIs and generated protocol schemas

scripts.generate:types: npm run generate:schema && tsc -p tsconfig.codegen.json && node dist-codegen/generateTypes.js generated/protocol-types.ts
scripts.smoke: npm run generate:types && npm run build && node dist/src/smoke/schema-smoke.js && node dist/src/smoke/client-smoke.js
